body:
Okay so there are different changes to different buildings

Bestiaries get access to higher tier followers (meaning you can't see a T9 pet in a lvl 6 bestiary)

Shops/Grand Market/Jeweler gets more items to sell and higher tier pools

Keep/Fortress/Castle gets more gold storage (1% of it every day as cashback basically) and more follower storage (if you're interested in collecting pets)

Town Hall gets higher tier quest access and more quests overall

Oracle Temple (one of if not only guild that can be leveled up) at lvl10 guarantees a Mnemonic everyday (after you perform the Concurrence ritual) 

Herbalist (I think) only gets access to higher tier recipes 

About Traveler's guild I'm not sure, apparently it does **something**

And Citadel (I think) increases the frequency of there being something as a gift from your citizens


As to what you should prioritise (IMO)

- Town Hall

- Bestiaries (5 should do)

- Keep

- and build the necessities (guild buildings and the Wayvessel)
